# Overlapping Hands Surrounding Small Heart — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_15/donation care hands heart 1_c4776ceb-e74e-4923-a8f4-ac3c1635d4e5.svg`
- source UUID: `c4776ceb-e74e-4923-a8f4-ac3c1635d4e5`
- classification: uncertain
- review: pending_human_review

A separate outlined heart occupies the blank interior of overlapping hands. The hands also form a heartlike outer contour, so the small heart may be an applied symbol or part of a unified caring-hands motif.

## Visual draft

Two overlapping hands form a broad rounded outer silhouette with fingers crossing along the lower edge. A small detached heart sits centrally inside the blank upper area enclosed by the hands.

## Open question

Should the central heart be isolated as a separate symbol, or is the full hand-and-heart motif the intended subject?

## 1. Overlapping hands (solo)

Two overlapping hands form a broad rounded contour with fingers crossing along the lower edge. Exclude the small central heart.

## 2. Small heart (sub)

A symmetrical heart with two rounded upper lobes and a pointed bottom. Exclude the surrounding hands.
